en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_desc: Chancellor Renn welcomes Heir Corvin in Halcyon Atoll and listens to his plea. Even though it seems that Commander Vex is now in full control, she still believes in a diplomatic solution. Renn sends her most renowned commander, Admiral Mori, as an Envoy to Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t1: I'm very grateful for your help, Chancellor.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t2: The pleasure is all mine. Welcome to Halcyon Atoll. It's been a while since you've visited us.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t3: I wish I could be here under more pleasant circumstances, but alas. I believe you have received my message about Commander Vex keeping my father hostage.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t4: Indeed I did. This is an unprecedented act of treachery. If not for the fact, that this news comes from you, and the skirmishes reported by Aurora forces, I wouldn't believe it.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t5: It's hard for me to believe it as well, my father trusted Vex.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t6: Can you help me, Chancellor? All I need is a contingent of soldiers. It is my wish to go back to Aurelian Bastion as quickly as possible and deal with Commander Vex myself. I believe, that there are still some Aurelian Holdings commanders, who would back me up if I confronted him directly.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t7: And it might as well be the case. Still, I think we should not rush things. You are still young, and the last thing Chairman Aurelian would want would be for his only son to charge into battle. I'm afraid you are not yet ready for such a difficult fight.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t8: I still hope that some diplomatic solution is possible. I have already dispatched my most trusted advisor as a diplomatic envoy, with a mission to Aurelian Bastion. He should be able to handle Vex.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t9: Is it a good idea? Vex ordered attacks on Aurora forces before.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t10: I don't know, but I want to try.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t11: My name is Verne, I'm a captain of the Aurora Concord army. This is Admiral Mori, a diplomatic envoy with a mission to Aurelian Bastion. We seek safe passage to your capital.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t12: Please wait, I'll notify the commander.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t13: ...yes, Commander. The envoy is here. Should I let him pass?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t14: Absolutely not. If they get here, they might interrupt my plans. I'm afraid, that if we were to simply tell the envoy to go back, they might try something else. Your orders are to arrest him.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t15: Arresting a diplomat is a serious incident.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t16: Do you think I don't know that? We are way too deep in this now. Arrest them.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t17: Apologies for the wait. I have to ask you to politely lay down any weapons you might be carrying.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t18: What is the meaning of this?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t19: Lay down your weapons, you are under arrest.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t21: This must be Vex's order. I'm afraid we will not comply.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t22: I don't think they will simply let us go, and we are outmatched. What now?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t23: I have already signaled nearby Airfield, that we are in distress.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t24: They should be able to provide us with some backup. Thanks to my passive ability, I can request flying units for less AP than usual.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t25: I need you to escort me back to our side of the border.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t26: And if they get too close, I can drop a rather nasty surprise on them.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t27: Aye aye. I'll make sure to get you out of here, sir. Let me know if you get hurt, I can heal you.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_o1: Evacuate Admiral Mori to the end of the road
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t28: Admiral has reached the extraction point.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t30: Don't loiter around, Captain. We're not in the clear just yet.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t31: Don't worry, Sir. I do not intend to overstay my welcome.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t32: I'm sorry, Admiral! There were too many of them!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t33: Save yourself, Verne! There is nothing more you can do...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_desc: With Commander Vex unwilling to let the Aurora Concord envoy through, Chancellor Renn orders a different approach. Admiral Mori must establish a corridor, that will allow him to move forces towards Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t2: Yes, madam Chancellor? I'm still assembling troops, as you requested.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t3: Good. Please keep me updated on the progress. We've got some intel, that several Aurelian Holdings officers are starting to question Vex's orders. They might side with Corvin when he returns, as he predicted.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t4: Aurelian Heir showed wisdom beyond his years. He will make a fine chairman someday.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t5: I hope so. Chairman Aurelian is a good friend, and I intend to prepare Corvin for the battles ahead of him.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t6: I'm sorry to interrupt you, Sir, but there is something going on on the Aurelian side...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t9: Aurelian Holdings just destroyed the bridge! They are trying to stop us from crossing the border river.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t10: That sly Commander! Admiral! I'm afraid that you have to act quickly, with whatever forces you have on hand.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t11: Agreed. But with this bridge gone...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t12: The only other way is the bridge in the city. I hoped we wouldn't have to fight near civilians.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t13: There is a border guard garrison over there. They should be able to hold out for now, but if Aurelian Holdings decides to attack in full force, they will need help.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t14: That sounds like a plan, Admiral. Capture the Aurelian HQ as quickly as possible, Chairman Aurelian needs our help.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t15: Looks like Aurora Concord is not going to give up. Blow it up, just in case.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t17: Sir, the city bridge is gone as well!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t18: They must have planted explosives before we got there. We're going to have to do this the hard way then. I need some veteran Attack Helicopters to ferry the troops.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t19: Objective captured, sir. Aurelian Holdings soldiers are falling back.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t20: Send a report to the Chancellor. Captain Verne has some bridge rebuilding to do before he will be able to bring in reinforcements.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_desc: Aurora Concord expedition hits a roadblock when they encounter a defensive line prepared by Aurelian Holdings. It didn't work out well for them so far. Do they have some other plan then?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t1: I have a bad feeling about the road ahead. I need a scout here!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t2: Let me be your eyes, Sir.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t3: Bad news! The road is heavily fortified. They are anticipating us.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t4: It's hard to tell, but I'm seeing something on the radar further down that path. I think the main base is even more guarded.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t5: I'm getting some readings from the mountain valley to the west, but can't see anything there.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t6: With no more bridges to blow up, Vex resorted to a wall of armoured units. What is the status of our camp?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t7: Almost done, Sir. The only problem is that most of the radar systems for the Towers arrived damaged. We managed to restore one to a working condition, so we have comms.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t9: The equipment looks smashed, we suspect it was sabotage.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t10: Someone sneaked up on us? Very worrying. We have to investigate this once we are done with Vex's roadblock. There are a few abandoned Aurelian Towers here, we have to capture them ASAP.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t11: Damn, those Aurora invaders! Requesting assistance!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t12: Finally! I was getting bored sitting in this valley.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t16: All units, assault Aurora Concord positions!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t17: Tell me, Admiral, have your radar equipment arrived yet?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t18: I should have known it was you. It was a smart move, I must admit. Who told you to do that? Because I doubt you came up with this on your own.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_o2: Claim all Aurelian Holdings and Meridian Combine buildings.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t20: I admire Vex's persistence, but this is not going to be enough to stop me.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t21: It is worrisome to see Meridian Combine still dealing with that traitor. I can only hope, that Director Voss will see that soon.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_desc: Despite his recent successes, Admiral Mori is forced to try and find an easier route towards Aurelian Bastion. On his way, he finds a Ferrovald Syndicate stronghold standing in his path. Chancellor Renn hopes to negotiate with them a safe passage.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t1: Halt! This area is under Ferrovald Syndicate's control.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t2: I am Admiral Mori of the Aurora Concord. We have no quarrel with you, we just seek passage on our way to Aurelian Bastion with a diplomatic mission.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t4: Greetings, Admiral. It's a pleasure to meet you. I wish it was under better circumstances. I understand that you want to pass through this road.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t5: Greetings, Commander. Yes, me and my forces need to get through here, and quick. I'm afraid we don't have time to waste.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t6: I wish I could help you, Admiral. But we are in quite a pickle here ourselves, and my orders forbid me from allowing you through.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t7: Can I talk with someone who can grant us an exemption then?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t8: Well... I'm afraid that it is not possible at this time. We have lost all communication with the central command.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t9: I understand. Still, as I said, time is of the essence. I have to pass, by any means necessary.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t10: You have your orders, Admiral, and I have mine.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t12: What now, Admiral? Are we punching through?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t13: I would very much rather avoid that. Any options?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t14: There seems to be an old path going around the mountain range. We would be taking a long way.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t15: Hmm, it still sounds better than a frontal attack.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t16: Ferrovald Syndicate is probably going to engage us here. I can't blame their Commander, he is following his orders after all.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t17: We have to fight them back, but only as much as is necessary. If we avoid capturing their production buildings, maybe we can convince them to help us fight Commander Vex.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t18: We have to claim these Towers, and hold this point, but don't go any further into Ferrovald Syndicate base. We just have to cover our forces going around.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t19: There are more entrances. I can see flanking Towers here as well.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t20: We have to capture all Towers along that path. Just remember to not claim any of their production buildings!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_o1: Claim all Towers along the alternative path
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_o2: Do not claim any Ferrovald Syndicate production buildings
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t22: Aurora Admiral truly is as powerful as they say. Let us keep our honor and finish this swiftly! It is a shame to end like this after Heiress Marchetti sacrificed his freedom so that we could get away from Meridian Combine.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t23: When I said, that I didn't have any quarrel with you, I really meant it, Commander. We have nothing to gain by wasting your lives. We just needed a way through.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t24: Was Heiress Marchetti your commanding officer? He sounds like a great man. What happened to him?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t25: We were stuck in a position near Aurelian Bastion when Meridian Combine attacked. Heiress Marchetti covered our retreat and was captured by Marshal Hale. We owe him our lives.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t26: Marshal Hale is a sensible man. If he is still there, I can negotiate the release of Heiress Marchetti on your behalf.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t27: If you could do that, Admiral, we would be in your debt.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t28: No! This is not the way to convince them to help us!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_desc: Driven both by his mission and a promise made to a Ferrovald Syndicate, Admiral Mori is ready to face Meridian Combine and Aurelian Holdings at the outskirts of the Aurelian Bastion. Facing two entrenched enemies is not going to be easy. Luckily, Captain Verne is already on his way with reinforcements.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t1: This is it, men! Aurelian Bastion is on the other bank of this lake. Chairman Aurelian needs our help, and we will not fail him!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t2: You can count on us, Admiral!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t4: Uh... Admiral! There is a problem!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t5: The south bridge is gone. They must have destroyed it to deny us entry.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t6: I can see a huge concentration of enemy units on the city streets. No way to enter from this side!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t7: Commander Vex must be getting desperate if he resorted to downright destroying bridges.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t9: Then we have to get there before they decide to blow it up as well.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t10: An Aurelian Holdings base is standing in our way, but we can deal with it.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t11: It looks like Meridian Combine is helping them.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t12: Did they respond to our requests to talk with Marshal Hale?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t14: I can't see any signs of his personal guard anywhere. It does not seem he's here.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t15: That's unfortunate. It would be way easier if we could talk.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t16: Captain Verne is already on his way with reinforcements. But we can't sit around and wait. Let's go!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_o1: Claim all Aurelian Holdings and Meridian Combine buildings
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t17: We surrender! All units, stand down!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t18: Admiral! We have found a prisoner. It's the Ferrovald Syndicate Noble.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t20: Aurora Concord? I swear, every time I'm pulled out of my cell, a new nation is being dragged into this mess.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t21: Since you're here. I would like to negotiate my release. I'm sure Foundermaster Ferron would gladly provide compensation in exchange for my freedom.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t22: (At least I hope so, after all I did...)
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t23: I hope you will prove to be more sensible than that tinhead Meridian Combine Commando.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t24: No need for that, Noble. I have already promised to your men, that I would do what I can to get you out of here. You are free to go to join your battalion, they are waiting.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t25: You are truly as honourable as they say, Admiral. I hope I will be able to repay the favour.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t26: We will cover your escape. You should go.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t28: Admiral, we've got a message from Captain Verne. He is coming in with new troops as we speak.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t31: Captain! What are you doing OVER THERE?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t32: I think we might have taken a wrong turn somewhere on the highway.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t34: Establish a position and push from there. We will make a pincer attack and take that Aurelian Holdings base.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t35: Objective achieved, Admiral. This base is a great spot to regroup before we take on that bridge and the city.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t36: Just look at those defences! Most of Vex's forces are on the streets right now. Even if we tried this, the potential for collateral damage is too high.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t37: Let's set up camp here. We can keep Aurelian Holdings in check, at least for now.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t38: As for you, Verne, I have a very important task...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_desc: While the expedition to Aurelian Bastion fails to reach its goal, Admiral Mori decides to stand his ground and keep Commander Vex busy. Captain Verne must race back to the Halcyon Atoll and report to Chancellor Renn, hoping that she can devise some new plan. Little does he know, that someone holding a grudge is watching him very closely...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t1: There they are! Alert all units!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t2: So far so good, but it looks like we might have run out of luck on this run.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t3: Admiral, this is Captain Verne. We are already past halfway to Aurora Lands, but we hit an obstacle. Lots of Meridian Combine soldiers stand in our way.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t4: Copy that, Captain. Let's have a look at the aerial recon.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t5: There are plenty of enemy Barracks ahead, but they all seem hastily set up. They are also sparsely guarded, with a few pieces of armour.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t6: We know of at least one facility capable of fielding new Tanks. But there may be more.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t7: They are using small islands to host simple Airfields, keeping them out of your reach. It does not seem they can provide Meridian Combine with heavier stuff, but their Scouts might still be a nuisance.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t8: There is a bigger concentration of forces near that town, but it looks like they have nothing beyond that point.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t9: If you can get there, Captain, You should be able to continue on your way without further issues.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t10: Got it, Admiral. Thank you for the intel.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t11: Focus, men. We are quite limited here. If anyone gets hurt, stay close to me or our Mobile Infantry units to get some assistance.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t12: I can't just hang in the back though, I must reach the end of that road personally.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_o1: Bring Captain Verne to the end of the road.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t13: We are almost in the clear. Form up and let's go as fast as we can.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t14: Don't think I'll let you go that easily. You WILL see me again!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t15: And I can't wait. Well... I guess I can because I don't have time for your silly antics.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t16: Can't see any more of them, Captain.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t18: Looks like we can only recruit basic Infantry in these Barracks. Even so, thanks to my passive ability, these soldiers will have enough experience to use their Heavy Weapons right away and be able to deal with anything Meridian Combine throws at us.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t19: Well, well, well. What is a wimpy Captain doing so far away from home?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t20: Borel! I should have expected, that such a lousy trap was your doing.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t21: You won't be so sassy when I beat you. Consider it revenge for interfering with my mission to capture Heir Corvin.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t22: What is this? Just look at this mess!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t23: Sir! They took away or smashed all the equipment before we could fully claim the building. It's not going to be useful anymore...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t24: You thought you got rid of me?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t26: These Barracks are trashed as well. Nothing but walls.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t27: I hope you liked the fireworks. I prepared them especially for you!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t29: Spotted a mine! Clear the building!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t30: I had hoped that the last one had taken care of you...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t31: It takes more than that to stop me!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t33: That is enough! Why don't you give up already?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t34: Why don't you? I think you should consider a different career. Street performer perhaps?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t35: You will regret that! I'm not holding back!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t37: Wait, what is that... Everyone out! It's a trap!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t39: Captain! Some of the nearby Towers were booby-trapped as well.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t40: They really don't want us to have these. It's the kind of solution I would expect from Borel.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t41: He's going for the detonator! Quick!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t43: That explosion still managed to knock out the power line to the Factory.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t44: And here I hoped for some more Tanks.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_desc: With Borel still hot on his heels, Captain Verne runs himself into a corner, facing a huge river on one side, and persistent Meridian Combine forces on the other. Aurora Concord forces are already devising a plan to get him across, but time is running out.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t1: That Commando is really persistent, I'll give him that.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t2: The rest of my men stayed behind to block the road. I hope they are fine.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t4: Some of them got through. I have to hurry!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t5: They are already on the eastern side as well? But there is no other way...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t7: Air brigade! So good to see you!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t8: Quickly, please get on board and we will ferry you to the other side.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t10: We can't leave! If we go now, those Meridian Combine forces in the east will flank our men covering my retreat. They would not be able to survive that!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t11: If only we could repair that bridge.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t12: There is actually an engineering team on the other side, I think they could pull this off. But it will take time...
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t13: Then we will give them time. We have to recall our forces covering the road right now. If we hold this side until the bridge is ready, they should make it.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t14: Sounds like a plan. Let us deploy our away team.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t15: A strike team is on the ground!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t16: These abandoned Aurelian Holdings buildings are not much but will have to be enough to hold this place.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t19: They are setting up quickly. Just look at them go!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t20: Looks like they might cut us off after all. Let's prepare!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t21: Ok, let's do this! One emergency bridge coming right up.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t22: This should do it. The bridge is stable enough.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t23: All we have to do now is to hold out until the rear guard catches up!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t24: You didn't think it would be that easy, didn't you Verne?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t25: You never learn, Borel. How many times do I have to beat you?
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t27: Then let's have it your way.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t28: I just have to beat that guy, and this will be over.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t29: The rear guard is here. Let's beat this clown and go home.
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t30: Argh! Why does it always end like this? Don't think you won, I will be back!
en.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t31: I wish I had time to chase you properly. But there are more important matters.

pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_desc: Chancellor Renn welcomes Heir Corvin in Halcyon Atoll and listens to his plea. Even though it seems that Commander Vex is now in full control, she still believes in a diplomatic solution. Renn sends her most renowned commander, Admiral Mori, as an Envoy to Aurelian Bastion.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t1: I'm very grateful for your help, Chancellor.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t2: The pleasure is all mine. Welcome to Halcyon Atoll. It's been a while since you've visited us.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t3: I wish I could be here under more pleasant circumstances, but alas. I believe you have received my message about Commander Vex keeping my father hostage.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t4: Indeed I did. This is an unprecedented act of treachery. If not for the fact, that this news comes from you, and the skirmishes reported by Aurora forces, I wouldn't believe it.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t5: It's hard for me to believe it as well, my father trusted Vex.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t6: Can you help me, Chancellor? All I need is a contingent of soldiers. It is my wish to go back to Aurelian Bastion as quickly as possible and deal with Commander Vex myself. I believe, that there are still some Aurelian Holdings commanders, who would back me up if I confronted him directly.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t7: And it might as well be the case. Still, I think we should not rush things. You are still young, and the last thing Chairman Aurelian would want would be for his only son to charge into battle. I'm afraid you are not yet ready for such a difficult fight.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t8: I still hope that some diplomatic solution is possible. I have already dispatched my most trusted advisor as a diplomatic envoy, with a mission to Aurelian Bastion. He should be able to handle Vex.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t9: Is it a good idea? Vex ordered attacks on Aurora forces before.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t10: I don't know, but I want to try.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t11: My name is Verne, I'm a captain of the Aurora Concord army. This is Admiral Mori, a diplomatic envoy with a mission to Aurelian Bastion. We seek safe passage to your capital.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t12: Please wait, I'll notify the commander.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t13: ...yes, Commander. The envoy is here. Should I let him pass?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t14: Absolutely not. If they get here, they might interrupt my plans. I'm afraid, that if we were to simply tell the envoy to go back, they might try something else. Your orders are to arrest him.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t15: Arresting a diplomat is a serious incident.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t16: Do you think I don't know that? We are way too deep in this now. Arrest them.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t17: Apologies for the wait. I have to ask you to politely lay down any weapons you might be carrying.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t18: What is the meaning of this?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t19: Lay down your weapons, you are under arrest.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t21: This must be Vex's order. I'm afraid we will not comply.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t22: I don't think they will simply let us go, and we are outmatched. What now?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t23: I have already signaled nearby Airfield, that we are in distress.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t24: They should be able to provide us with some backup. Thanks to my passive ability, I can request flying units for less AP than usual.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t25: I need you to escort me back to our side of the border.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t26: And if they get too close, I can drop a rather nasty surprise on them.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t27: Aye aye. I'll make sure to get you out of here, sir. Let me know if you get hurt, I can heal you.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_o1: Evacuate Admiral Mori to the end of the road
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t28: Admiral has reached the extraction point.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t30: Don't loiter around, Captain. We're not in the clear just yet.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t31: Don't worry, Sir. I do not intend to overstay my welcome.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t32: I'm sorry, Admiral! There were too many of them!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m1_t33: Save yourself, Verne! There is nothing more you can do...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_desc: With Commander Vex unwilling to let the Aurora Concord envoy through, Chancellor Renn orders a different approach. Admiral Mori must establish a corridor, that will allow him to move forces towards Aurelian Bastion.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t2: Yes, madam Chancellor? I'm still assembling troops, as you requested.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t3: Good. Please keep me updated on the progress. We've got some intel, that several Aurelian Holdings officers are starting to question Vex's orders. They might side with Corvin when he returns, as he predicted.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t4: Aurelian Heir showed wisdom beyond his years. He will make a fine chairman someday.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t5: I hope so. Chairman Aurelian is a good friend, and I intend to prepare Corvin for the battles ahead of him.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t6: I'm sorry to interrupt you, Sir, but there is something going on on the Aurelian side...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t9: Aurelian Holdings just destroyed the bridge! They are trying to stop us from crossing the border river.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t10: That sly Commander! Admiral! I'm afraid that you have to act quickly, with whatever forces you have on hand.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t11: Agreed. But with this bridge gone...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t12: The only other way is the bridge in the city. I hoped we wouldn't have to fight near civilians.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t13: There is a border guard garrison over there. They should be able to hold out for now, but if Aurelian Holdings decides to attack in full force, they will need help.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t14: That sounds like a plan, Admiral. Capture the Aurelian HQ as quickly as possible, Chairman Aurelian needs our help.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t15: Looks like Aurora Concord is not going to give up. Blow it up, just in case.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t17: Sir, the city bridge is gone as well!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t18: They must have planted explosives before we got there. We're going to have to do this the hard way then. I need some veteran Attack Helicopters to ferry the troops.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t19: Objective captured, sir. Aurelian Holdings soldiers are falling back.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m2_t20: Send a report to the Chancellor. Captain Verne has some bridge rebuilding to do before he will be able to bring in reinforcements.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_desc: Aurora Concord expedition hits a roadblock when they encounter a defensive line prepared by Aurelian Holdings. It didn't work out well for them so far. Do they have some other plan then?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t1: I have a bad feeling about the road ahead. I need a scout here!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t2: Let me be your eyes, Sir.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t3: Bad news! The road is heavily fortified. They are anticipating us.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t4: It's hard to tell, but I'm seeing something on the radar further down that path. I think the main base is even more guarded.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t5: I'm getting some readings from the mountain valley to the west, but can't see anything there.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t6: With no more bridges to blow up, Vex resorted to a wall of armoured units. What is the status of our camp?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t7: Almost done, Sir. The only problem is that most of the radar systems for the Towers arrived damaged. We managed to restore one to a working condition, so we have comms.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t9: The equipment looks smashed, we suspect it was sabotage.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t10: Someone sneaked up on us? Very worrying. We have to investigate this once we are done with Vex's roadblock. There are a few abandoned Aurelian Towers here, we have to capture them ASAP.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t11: Damn, those Aurora invaders! Requesting assistance!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t12: Finally! I was getting bored sitting in this valley.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t16: All units, assault Aurora Concord positions!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t17: Tell me, Admiral, have your radar equipment arrived yet?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t18: I should have known it was you. It was a smart move, I must admit. Who told you to do that? Because I doubt you came up with this on your own.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_o2: Claim all Aurelian Holdings and Meridian Combine buildings.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t20: I admire Vex's persistence, but this is not going to be enough to stop me.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m3_t21: It is worrisome to see Meridian Combine still dealing with that traitor. I can only hope, that Director Voss will see that soon.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_desc: Despite his recent successes, Admiral Mori is forced to try and find an easier route towards Aurelian Bastion. On his way, he finds a Ferrovald Syndicate stronghold standing in his path. Chancellor Renn hopes to negotiate with them a safe passage.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t1: Halt! This area is under Ferrovald Syndicate's control.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t2: I am Admiral Mori of the Aurora Concord. We have no quarrel with you, we just seek passage on our way to Aurelian Bastion with a diplomatic mission.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t4: Greetings, Admiral. It's a pleasure to meet you. I wish it was under better circumstances. I understand that you want to pass through this road.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t5: Greetings, Commander. Yes, me and my forces need to get through here, and quick. I'm afraid we don't have time to waste.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t6: I wish I could help you, Admiral. But we are in quite a pickle here ourselves, and my orders forbid me from allowing you through.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t7: Can I talk with someone who can grant us an exemption then?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t8: Well... I'm afraid that it is not possible at this time. We have lost all communication with the central command.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t9: I understand. Still, as I said, time is of the essence. I have to pass, by any means necessary.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t10: You have your orders, Admiral, and I have mine.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t12: What now, Admiral? Are we punching through?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t13: I would very much rather avoid that. Any options?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t14: There seems to be an old path going around the mountain range. We would be taking a long way.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t15: Hmm, it still sounds better than a frontal attack.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t16: Ferrovald Syndicate is probably going to engage us here. I can't blame their Commander, he is following his orders after all.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t17: We have to fight them back, but only as much as is necessary. If we avoid capturing their production buildings, maybe we can convince them to help us fight Commander Vex.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t18: We have to claim these Towers, and hold this point, but don't go any further into Ferrovald Syndicate base. We just have to cover our forces going around.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t19: There are more entrances. I can see flanking Towers here as well.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t20: We have to capture all Towers along that path. Just remember to not claim any of their production buildings!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_o1: Claim all Towers along the alternative path
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_o2: Do not claim any Ferrovald Syndicate production buildings
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t22: Aurora Admiral truly is as powerful as they say. Let us keep our honor and finish this swiftly! It is a shame to end like this after Heiress Marchetti sacrificed his freedom so that we could get away from Meridian Combine.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t23: When I said, that I didn't have any quarrel with you, I really meant it, Commander. We have nothing to gain by wasting your lives. We just needed a way through.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t24: Was Heiress Marchetti your commanding officer? He sounds like a great man. What happened to him?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t25: We were stuck in a position near Aurelian Bastion when Meridian Combine attacked. Heiress Marchetti covered our retreat and was captured by Marshal Hale. We owe him our lives.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t26: Marshal Hale is a sensible man. If he is still there, I can negotiate the release of Heiress Marchetti on your behalf.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t27: If you could do that, Admiral, we would be in your debt.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m4_t28: No! This is not the way to convince them to help us!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_desc: Driven both by his mission and a promise made to a Ferrovald Syndicate, Admiral Mori is ready to face Meridian Combine and Aurelian Holdings at the outskirts of the Aurelian Bastion. Facing two entrenched enemies is not going to be easy. Luckily, Captain Verne is already on his way with reinforcements.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t1: This is it, men! Aurelian Bastion is on the other bank of this lake. Chairman Aurelian needs our help, and we will not fail him!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t2: You can count on us, Admiral!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t4: Uh... Admiral! There is a problem!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t5: The south bridge is gone. They must have destroyed it to deny us entry.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t6: I can see a huge concentration of enemy units on the city streets. No way to enter from this side!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t7: Commander Vex must be getting desperate if he resorted to downright destroying bridges.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t9: Then we have to get there before they decide to blow it up as well.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t10: An Aurelian Holdings base is standing in our way, but we can deal with it.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t11: It looks like Meridian Combine is helping them.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t12: Did they respond to our requests to talk with Marshal Hale?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t14: I can't see any signs of his personal guard anywhere. It does not seem he's here.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t15: That's unfortunate. It would be way easier if we could talk.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t16: Captain Verne is already on his way with reinforcements. But we can't sit around and wait. Let's go!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_o1: Claim all Aurelian Holdings and Meridian Combine buildings
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t17: We surrender! All units, stand down!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t18: Admiral! We have found a prisoner. It's the Ferrovald Syndicate Noble.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t20: Aurora Concord? I swear, every time I'm pulled out of my cell, a new nation is being dragged into this mess.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t21: Since you're here. I would like to negotiate my release. I'm sure Foundermaster Ferron would gladly provide compensation in exchange for my freedom.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t22: (At least I hope so, after all I did...)
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t23: I hope you will prove to be more sensible than that tinhead Meridian Combine Commando.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t24: No need for that, Noble. I have already promised to your men, that I would do what I can to get you out of here. You are free to go to join your battalion, they are waiting.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t25: You are truly as honourable as they say, Admiral. I hope I will be able to repay the favour.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t26: We will cover your escape. You should go.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t28: Admiral, we've got a message from Captain Verne. He is coming in with new troops as we speak.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t31: Captain! What are you doing OVER THERE?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t32: I think we might have taken a wrong turn somewhere on the highway.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t34: Establish a position and push from there. We will make a pincer attack and take that Aurelian Holdings base.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t35: Objective achieved, Admiral. This base is a great spot to regroup before we take on that bridge and the city.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t36: Just look at those defences! Most of Vex's forces are on the streets right now. Even if we tried this, the potential for collateral damage is too high.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t37: Let's set up camp here. We can keep Aurelian Holdings in check, at least for now.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m5_t38: As for you, Verne, I have a very important task...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_desc: While the expedition to Aurelian Bastion fails to reach its goal, Admiral Mori decides to stand his ground and keep Commander Vex busy. Captain Verne must race back to the Halcyon Atoll and report to Chancellor Renn, hoping that she can devise some new plan. Little does he know, that someone holding a grudge is watching him very closely...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t1: There they are! Alert all units!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t2: So far so good, but it looks like we might have run out of luck on this run.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t3: Admiral, this is Captain Verne. We are already past halfway to Aurora Lands, but we hit an obstacle. Lots of Meridian Combine soldiers stand in our way.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t4: Copy that, Captain. Let's have a look at the aerial recon.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t5: There are plenty of enemy Barracks ahead, but they all seem hastily set up. They are also sparsely guarded, with a few pieces of armour.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t6: We know of at least one facility capable of fielding new Tanks. But there may be more.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t7: They are using small islands to host simple Airfields, keeping them out of your reach. It does not seem they can provide Meridian Combine with heavier stuff, but their Scouts might still be a nuisance.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t8: There is a bigger concentration of forces near that town, but it looks like they have nothing beyond that point.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t9: If you can get there, Captain, You should be able to continue on your way without further issues.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t10: Got it, Admiral. Thank you for the intel.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t11: Focus, men. We are quite limited here. If anyone gets hurt, stay close to me or our Mobile Infantry units to get some assistance.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t12: I can't just hang in the back though, I must reach the end of that road personally.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_o1: Bring Captain Verne to the end of the road.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t13: We are almost in the clear. Form up and let's go as fast as we can.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t14: Don't think I'll let you go that easily. You WILL see me again!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t15: And I can't wait. Well... I guess I can because I don't have time for your silly antics.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t16: Can't see any more of them, Captain.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t18: Looks like we can only recruit basic Infantry in these Barracks. Even so, thanks to my passive ability, these soldiers will have enough experience to use their Heavy Weapons right away and be able to deal with anything Meridian Combine throws at us.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t19: Well, well, well. What is a wimpy Captain doing so far away from home?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t20: Borel! I should have expected, that such a lousy trap was your doing.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t21: You won't be so sassy when I beat you. Consider it revenge for interfering with my mission to capture Heir Corvin.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t22: What is this? Just look at this mess!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t23: Sir! They took away or smashed all the equipment before we could fully claim the building. It's not going to be useful anymore...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t24: You thought you got rid of me?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t26: These Barracks are trashed as well. Nothing but walls.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t27: I hope you liked the fireworks. I prepared them especially for you!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t29: Spotted a mine! Clear the building!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t30: I had hoped that the last one had taken care of you...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t31: It takes more than that to stop me!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t33: That is enough! Why don't you give up already?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t34: Why don't you? I think you should consider a different career. Street performer perhaps?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t35: You will regret that! I'm not holding back!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t37: Wait, what is that... Everyone out! It's a trap!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t39: Captain! Some of the nearby Towers were booby-trapped as well.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t40: They really don't want us to have these. It's the kind of solution I would expect from Borel.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t41: He's going for the detonator! Quick!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t43: That explosion still managed to knock out the power line to the Factory.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m6_t44: And here I hoped for some more Tanks.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_desc: With Borel still hot on his heels, Captain Verne runs himself into a corner, facing a huge river on one side, and persistent Meridian Combine forces on the other. Aurora Concord forces are already devising a plan to get him across, but time is running out.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t1: That Commando is really persistent, I'll give him that.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t2: The rest of my men stayed behind to block the road. I hope they are fine.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t4: Some of them got through. I have to hurry!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t5: They are already on the eastern side as well? But there is no other way...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t7: Air brigade! So good to see you!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t8: Quickly, please get on board and we will ferry you to the other side.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t10: We can't leave! If we go now, those Meridian Combine forces in the east will flank our men covering my retreat. They would not be able to survive that!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t11: If only we could repair that bridge.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t12: There is actually an engineering team on the other side, I think they could pull this off. But it will take time...
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t13: Then we will give them time. We have to recall our forces covering the road right now. If we hold this side until the bridge is ready, they should make it.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t14: Sounds like a plan. Let us deploy our away team.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t15: A strike team is on the ground!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t16: These abandoned Aurelian Holdings buildings are not much but will have to be enough to hold this place.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t19: They are setting up quickly. Just look at them go!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t20: Looks like they might cut us off after all. Let's prepare!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t21: Ok, let's do this! One emergency bridge coming right up.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t22: This should do it. The bridge is stable enough.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t23: All we have to do now is to hold out until the rear guard catches up!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t24: You didn't think it would be that easy, didn't you Verne?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t25: You never learn, Borel. How many times do I have to beat you?
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t27: Then let's have it your way.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t28: I just have to beat that guy, and this will be over.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t29: The rear guard is here. Let's beat this clown and go home.
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t30: Argh! Why does it always end like this? Don't think you won, I will be back!
pl.tr_core_jade_twilight_m7_t31: I wish I had time to chase you properly. But there are more important matters.
